description: This module provides a wrapper around the A2A protocol SDK, including functions for message sending, agent card retrieval, and client creation, with detailed example usages.

classes.name: A2AClient
classes.description: A class-based client wrapper for the A2A protocol, providing methods to send messages to agents.

methods.name: asend_message
methods.description: Asynchronous function to send a message request via the A2A protocol.

methods.name: aget_agent_card
methods.description: Retrieve the agent card information asynchronously.

methods.name: create_a2a_client
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of A2AClient configured with the given base URL.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Function to send a message using the A2A protocol.
